hero.description: A pilgrimage of endurance across Nepal's sacred peaks and high corridors since 1993. Guided by veteran IFMGA/NMA Sherpa masters with zero safety compromise.

about.title: We do not sell holidays.
about.description: We orchestrate passages through the highest corridors on Earth—where the air thins, the noise dies, and what remains is raw clarity. Every step above 4,000 meters is a negotiation between the body and the mountain, and the mountain always remembers.
about.floating_label: Years guiding Himalayan paths without a single major safety compromise.

contact.title: Visit our Kathmandu HQ
contact.description: Drop by our Thamel headquarters or ring our certified support desk around the clock.
contact.regions: Nepal Himalayas, Tibet Sacred Circuits, Bhutan cultural tours.

packages.title: Everest Base Camp
packages.name: Everest Base Camp
packages.summary: The classic pilgrimage to the foot of Sagarmatha.
itinerary: Day 1: Scenic flight to Lukla (2,860m) & Trek to Phakding (2,610m)
Day 2: Trek from Phakding to the legendary Namche Bazaar (3,440m)
Day 3: Acclimatization rest day in Namche Bazaar; hike to Everest View Hotel
Day 4: Trek from Namche to Tengboche Monastery (3,860m)
Day 5: Trek to Dingboche (4,410m) - beautiful views of Ama Dablam
Day 6: Second Acclimatization Day in Dingboche; peak trek preparation
Day 7: Dingboche to Lobuche (4,910m) along the lateral moraine
Day 8: Lobuche to Gorakshep (5,140m), Trek to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) & return
Day 9: Hike Kala Patthar (5,545m) for sunrise, then descend to Pheriche (4,240m)
Day 10: Descend from Pheriche back down to Namche Bazaar
Day 11: Namche Bazaar to Lukla
Day 12: Scenic flight Lukla to Kathmandu; celebration dinner
included: Lukla flight round-trip ticket with cargo allowance
Government certified expert local Sherpa guide
All required TIMS card and Sagarmatha national park permits
Teahouse accommodation with three meals daily during the trek
Emergency first-aid medical kit and oximeter monitoring
Porter service (1 porter for every 2 trekkers)
excluded: Nepal tourist visa fees and international flights
Personal gear and high-altitude gear hire
Hot showers, Wi-Fi, and electronic charging fees on-trail
Tips for guides and local support crew

packages.title: Annapurna Circuit
packages.name: Annapurna Circuit
packages.summary: A circular traverse crossing the Thorong La pass.
itinerary: Day 1: Drive from Kathmandu to Besisahar & Chame (2,670m)
Day 2: Trek from Chame to Pisang (3,200m)
Day 3: Trek from Pisang to Manang (3,540m) via upper trail
Day 4: Acclimatization and exploration in Manang
Day 5: Trek from Manang to Yak Kharka (4,050m)
Day 6: Trek to Thorong Phedi / High Camp (4,800m)
Day 7: Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m) to sacred Muktinath (3,760m)
Day 8: Muktinath to Marpha village
Day 9: Marpha to Kalopani through Kali Gandaki gorge
Day 10: Kalopani to Tatopani hot springs
Day 11: Tatopani to Ghorepani (2,860m)
Day 12: Sunrise hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) & trek to Tadapani
Day 13: Tadapani to Ghandruk village
Day 14: Ghandruk to Nayapul and scenic drive to Pokhara
Day 15: Rest day in lakeside Pokhara
Day 16: Return scenic drive/flight to Kathmandu
included: All land transportation and permits (ACAP & TIMS)
Certified Annapurna mountain guide and porters
All teahouse lodges and wholesome mountain meals
Emergency oxygen and first aid kit
excluded: Hot springs fee, personal beverages and snacks

packages.title: Manaslu Circuit
packages.name: Manaslu Circuit
packages.summary: A remote restricted-zone loop around the spirit mountain.
itinerary: Day 1: Drive from Kathmandu to Machha Khola (900m)
Day 2: Trek from Machha Khola to Jagat (1,340m)
Day 3: Jagat to Deng (1,860m)
Day 4: Deng to Namrung (2,630m)
Day 5: Namrung to Lho (3,180m) - first close view of Mount Manaslu
Day 6: Lho to Samagaon (3,530m)
Day 7: Acclimatization day at Samagaon, hike to Manaslu Base Camp (4,400m)
Day 8: Samagaon to Samdo (3,860m)
Day 9: Acclimatization hike towards Tibetan border from Samdo
Day 10: Samdo to Dharamsala / Larkya Phedi (4,460m)
Day 11: Cross the dramatic Larkya La Pass (5,106m) to Bimthang (3,590m)
Day 12: Bimthang to Tilije (2,300m)
Day 13: Tilije to Tal (1,700m)
Day 14: Tal to Syange
Day 15: Syange to Besisahar
Day 16: Drive to Pokhara
Day 17: Pokhara exploration
Day 18: Drive / flight back to Kathmandu
included: Manaslu Restricted Area Special Permit (RAP) & MCAP
Government-licensed mountain guide with high-altitude satellite link
All teahouse stays and complete 3-meal plan
